name: Prefill only, 8k input
description: 10 single-stream requests with a 8k-token document and only 16 output tokens, so almost all of the time is prefill. Reported as prefill_tok_s = input tokens / time to first token. Run all three to see how prefill throughput changes with length; on most engines it falls well before the context limit.
notes: Documents come from the haystack-v1 items whose target_tokens is 8192, materialised with datasets/haystack-v1/build.py and cycled over the three needle depths. The needle answer is not scored here.
